columns.name: SSL SCORE
columns.description: Strategic Subject List Score.

columns.name: PREDICTOR RAT AGE AT LATEST ARREST
columns.description: Attribute RAW Score; The raw score calculated by the model; The individual's age at the time of their most recent arrest.

columns.name: PREDICTOR RAT VICTIM SHOOTING INCIDENTS
columns.description: Attribute RAW Score; The raw score calculated by the model; The number of times an individual has been the victim of a shooting.

columns.name: PREDICTOR RAT VICTIM BATTERY OR ASSAULT
columns.description: Attribute RAW Score; The raw score calculated by the model; The number of times an individual has been the victim of an aggravated battery or aggravated assault; .

columns.name: PREDICTOR RAT ARRESTS VIOLENT OFFENSES
columns.description: Attribute RAW Score; The raw score calculated by the model; The number of times the individual has been arrested for a violent offense.

columns.name: PREDICTOR RAT GANG AFFILIATION
columns.description: Attribute RAW Score; The raw score calculated by the model; Indicator if an individual has been confirmed to be a member of a criminal street gang. 1=Yes; 0=No

columns.name: PREDICTOR RAT NARCOTIC ARRESTS
columns.description: Attribute RAW Score; The raw score calculated by the model; The number of times the individual has been arrested for a narcotics offense.

columns.name: PREDICTOR RAT TREND IN CRIMINAL ACTIVITY
columns.description: Attribute RAW Score; The raw score calculated by the model; The trend of an individual's recent criminal activity.

columns.name: PREDICTOR RAT UUW ARRESTS
columns.description: Attribute RAW Score; The raw score calculated by the model; The number of times the individual has been arrested for Unlawful Use of Weapons.

columns.name: SEX CODE CD
columns.description: Subject's Sex as of their latest arrest record.

columns.name: RACE CODE CD
WEAPON I
columns.description: Is 'Y' if at least one Weapon (UUW) Arrest in past 10 years.

columns.name: DRUG I
columns.description: Is 'Y' if at least one Drug Arrest in past 10 years.

columns.name: AGE GROUP
columns.description: Subject's Age as of their latest arrest record.

columns.name: AGE TO
columns.description: If Age is an estimated range, this is the upper end of that range

columns.name: STOP ORDER NO
columns.description: If an outstanding investigative alert exists for this subject, this is the Investigative Alert (previously known as Stop Order) number.

columns.name: PAROLEE I
columns.description: Is 'Y' if the subject is matched with a recent Illinois Department of Corrections Record indicating the subject is currently on Parole.

columns.name: LATEST DATE
columns.description: Latest date of police contact.

columns.name: LATEST DIST
columns.description: Police District in which latest contact occurred.

columns.name: MAJORITY DIST
columns.description: Police District in which the largest number of contacts occurred.

columns.name: DLST
columns.description: State of issue for Latest of entry of Subject's Drivers License Number (if any) found in any arrest record.

columns.name: LATEST DIST RES
columns.description: District of Residence as of the subject's latest arrest record.

columns.name: WEAPONS ARR CNT
columns.description: Count of Weapons (UUW) Arrests in last 10 years.

columns.name: LATEST WEAPON ARR DATE
columns.description: Date of Latest Weapons (UUW) Arrest .

columns.name: NARCOTICS ARR CNT
columns.description: Count of Drug Arrests in last 10 years.

columns.name: LATEST NARCOTIC ARR DATE
columns.description: Date of Latest Drug Arrest .

columns.name: IDOC RES CITY
columns.description: Subject's City of Residence as entered on a matching Illinois Department of Corrections Record.

columns.name: IDOC RES STATE CODE
columns.description: Subject's State of Residence as entered on a matching Illinois Department of Corrections Record.

columns.name: IDOC RES ZIP CODE
columns.description: Subject's Zip Code of Residence as entered on a matching Illinois Department of Corrections Record.

columns.name: IDOC CPD DIST
columns.description: Police District associated with Subject's Address of Residence as entered on a matching Illinois Department of Corrections Record.

columns.name: CPD ARREST I
columns.description: Is 'Y' if most recent arrest is a Chicago Police arrest and not a surrounding County arrest.

columns.name: DOMESTIC ARR CNT
columns.description: Count of Domestic Violence Arrests in last 10 years.

columns.name: LATEST DOMESTIC ARR DATE
columns.description: Date of Latest Domestic Violence Arrest .

columns.name: AGE CURR
columns.description: Subject's Current Age.

columns.name: SSL LAST PTV DATE
columns.description: Most recent date that the subject was matched with a victim or arrest record making the subject a 'Party to Violence'

columns.name: TRAP STATUS
columns.description: Severity category using the old (Pre-2015) Targeted Repeat Offender Program.(TRAP) criteria.

columns.name: RAW SSL SCORE
columns.description: An intermediate version of the SSL score prior to being normalized that was a byproduct of earlier predictive models.

columns.name: HEAT SCORE
columns.description: Same as SSL_SCORE.

columns.name: RAW_HEAT_SCORE
columns.description: Same as RAW_SSL_SCORE.

columns.name: STATUS I
columns.description: Is 'Y' if SSL_SCORE is the latest version of the score for this subject.

columns.name: PRE RAW HEAT SCORE
columns.description: An integer-scaled version of the RAW_SSL_SCORE.

columns.name: TRAP FLAGS
columns.description: One or more police units flagged as associated with the subject for purposes of the Targeted Repeat Offender program.

columns.name: SSL FLAGS
columns.description: One or more police units flagged as associated with the subject for purposes of the Strategic Subjects List program.

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: Latitude of Centroid of Census Tract of Arrest for the Subject's latest arrest record.

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: Longitude of Centroid of Census Tract of Arrest for the Subject's latest arrest record.

columns.name: CENSUS TRACT
columns.description: Census Tract of Arrest for the Subject's latest arrest record.

columns.name: COMMUNITY AREA
columns.description: Community Area of Arrest for the Subject's latest arrest record.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Centroid of Census Tract of Arrest for the Subject's latest arrest record.
